messages:
deploy-bot: starting canary rollout v2.14.0 -> canary (10% traffic). Changes: model routing tweak + KV-cache prewarm. started at 2026-03-17T14:22:35Z

maria: seeing healthcheck failures on canary hosts, alerting now :rotating_light:

jess: alert shows 5xx rate ~3.8% over the last 2m, healthcheck failures across 6/10 canary instances

kevin: whats the abort criteria?

jess: abort = 2% 5xx sustained for 5m (auto-abort enabled). looks like we're trending over that. paging oncall.

ops-bot: AUTO-ABORT TRIGGERED — canary 5xx > 2% for 5m. Initiating rollback sequence and paging on-call.

maria: :rotating_light: Pager — canary abort triggered, I'm taking the incident. Starting immediate mitigation.

kevin: checking logs, seeing a spike in upstream connection resets from inference-hosts that received prewarm traffic. suspect thundering herd from KV-cache prewarm.

jess: can confirm spike aligns with prewarm start time. requests queueing then timeouts -> 503s.

deployer: that prewarm was from the new routing policy, i pushed the flag. If we flip routing back we can stop warming new path.

maria: flip the flag and we'll monitor. command to flip:
```
POST /internal/flags/canary-routing 
{ "enabled": false }
```

deployer: flipping flag now...

deployer: flag flip complete, confirmed in console. stopping prewarm.

ops-bot: traffic shift: redirecting canary traffic back to stable variant. rollback of v2.14.0 to v2.13.9 initiated.

kevin: 5xx down to ~0.6% over the last 90s, healthchecks passing on all canary instances.

jess: great — checking customer impact. Early estimate: a small window (~2.5 minutes) where ~0.5% of user requests routed to canary got 503s. No broad customer escalations yet.

maria: notifying support and marking incident as mitigated. @support-bot please crate a customer advisory draft if needed.

support-bot: draft created and queued for review. No customers currently escalated.

kevin: I'll own the postmortem and follow-up. Will collect host logs, nginx/inference traces, and flag rollout timeline. ETA 30m for initial doc.

maria: handing ongoing follow-up to kevin — I'm unassigning from pager. Thanks all for quick response. :thumbsup:

jess: recommend adding a short safety delay before prewarm during canary to avoid thundering herd next rollout.

kevin: noted. will include mitigation and preventive action items in postmortem.

maria: closing immediate incident. keep thread updated with postmortem link when ready.
